description: Connect Cloudflare and other hosting providers so the agent can inspect domains and manage approved DNS records.
skill_summary: How to use saved hosting-provider connections, inspect domains and DNS records, and make deliberate DNS changes without exposing provider credentials.
note: Cloudflare, DigitalOcean, Route 53, Google Cloud DNS, Namecheap, Porkbun, and manual DNS are discovered from the installed provider registry.
